stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig announces pancake day
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): What special food is Mummy Pig making for everyone today?
Options:
A) Pancakes 🥞
B) Pizza 🍕
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Pancakes!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig holds the frying pan
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Action): What is Daddy Pig holding in his hand?
Options:
A) A frying pan 🍳
B) A spoon 🥄
Guidance: Encourage the child to identify the pan: 'A frying pan!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig claims there was a problem with the pan
stopPoints.question:
Question (Character & Dialogue): Who dropped the pancake on the floor last time?
Options:
A) Daddy Pig 👓
B) Peppa Pig 🐷
Guidance: Ask the child: 'Who was it?' and guide them to answer: 'Daddy Pig!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig pours flour into the bowl
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What white ingredient does Mummy Pig pour into the bowl first?
Options:
A) Flour 🌾
B) Sugar 🍬
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Flour!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig cracks an egg into the bowl
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Action): What does Mummy Pig crack and add into the bowl next?
Options:
A) An egg 🥚
B) An apple 🍎
Guidance: Prompt the child to notice the egg: 'An egg!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig pours milk from the jug
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What liquid is Mummy Pig pouring into the bowl?
Options:
A) Milk 🥛
B) Orange juice 🍊
Guidance: Guide the child to answer: 'Milk!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and George stir the batter together
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): Where did the batter splash onto Peppa and George's faces?
Options:
A) On their noses and cheeks 🐽
B) On their shoes 👟
Guidance: Encourage the child to laugh and point: 'On their noses!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig flips the pancake over
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): What did Mummy Pig just do to the pancake in the frying pan?
Options:
A) Flipped it over 🥞
B) Ate it up 😋
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Flipped it over!'

stopPoints.label: George receives the first pancake with syrup
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): What sweet syrup does Mummy Pig squeeze onto George's pancake?
Options:
A) Maple syrup 🍁
B) Tomato ketchup 🍅
Guidance: Point out the bottle with the leaf and say: 'Syrup!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa gets her pancake
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): Who gets the second delicious pancake?
Options:
A) Peppa Pig 👧
B) Daddy Pig 👓
Guidance: Ask the child: 'Whose turn is it?' and encourage: 'Peppa!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig gets ready to cook his pancake
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): Whose turn is it next to flip a pancake?
Options:
A) Daddy Pig 🐷
B) George 🦖
Guidance: Encourage the child to answer: 'Daddy Pig!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig flips the pancake too high
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action & Visual): Where did Daddy Pig's pancake go when he flipped it?
Options:
A) Stuck on the ceiling ☁️
B) Into his tummy 🍽️
Guidance: Prompt the child to look up: 'Up on the ceiling!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig stands on the table trying to reach
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What is Daddy Pig standing on to reach the ceiling?
Options:
A) The dining table 🪑
B) A tall ladder 🪜
Guidance: Encourage the child to point out: 'The table!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig and the children jump upstairs
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): What are Mummy Pig, Peppa, and George doing in the bedroom upstairs?
Options:
A) Jumping up and down 🦘
B) Sleeping in bed 🛏️
Guidance: Encourage the child to jump and say: 'Jumping up and down!'

stopPoints.label: The pancake lands on Daddy Pig's head
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): Where did the pancake land when it fell down?
Options:
A) On Daddy Pig's head 🥞
B) In the kitchen sink 🚰
Guidance: Encourage the child to giggle and point: 'On Daddy Pig's head!'
